## May 2026
- GPT Realtime 2.0 (preview) overview — reasoning support, response phases (preamble and final answer), stricter instruction following.
  URL: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/foundry-classic/openai/concepts/realtime-2
- GPT Realtime Translate concept article (May 2026)
- GPT Realtime Whisper concept article (May 2026)

## February 2026
- gpt-realtime-1.5, gpt-audio-1.5 models

## December 2025
- gpt-image-1.5 (image generation with face preservation, up to 1024x1536 / 1536x1024)
- gpt-4o-mini-transcribe-2025-12-15 (ASR update, 50% lower WER)
- gpt-realtime-mini-2025-12-15
- gpt-4o-mini-tts-2025-12-15

## October 2025
- Realtime API support for SIP
- gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize model
- gpt-image-1-mini
